description: Persist a journal entry DIRECTLY to the journal, with NO review step. This is the silent/import-only path — for an ordinary chat request like "save this as a journal entry" / "journal this" / "add a journal entry", do NOT use this; use `compose_entry`, which opens an editable composer the user confirms. Reach for `create_entry` ONLY for silent/automated saves: structured memory-inventory imports, or when the user explicitly asks to save without reviewing. `content` is the only required field. For imports, include entryDate, entryDateDisplay, location, sourceMemoryId, sourceSection, sourceTitle, sourceType, dateConfidence, sensitivity, tags, and metadata when known. Returns the saved entry including its `id`, which can then be used to turn the entry into a song linked to it (the track generator accepts a journal entry id).

content.description: The reflection text to save as a journal entry.

entryDateDisplay.description: Human-readable date label, e.g. "ete 1973" or "date approximative".

metadata.description: Flexible JSON metadata for import/review context.

moodContext.description: Optional short note on the mood/context. Usually omit.

sensitivity.description: Suggested values: normal, private, sensitive, very_sensitive.

sourceMemoryId.description: External memory inventory id, e.g. M021.

sourceType.description: Suggested values: book_memory, journal_import, manual_entry, song_reflection.

type.description: Optional entry type, e.g. 'reflection' (default), 'note', 'insight'. Usually omit.

name: create_entry
title: Save a journal entry silently (import only)
